H2.timing_caveat: CPI workbook supplies reference months and reported rates but no publication timestamps or expectations. Same-month analysis is contemporaneous and may use information published after some/all of the market-return month. One-reference-month lag is a timing sensitivity, not proof that the exact release was available before each return.

H3.timing_caveat: The workbook provides reserve observation week-end but not first public-release timestamps. Same-week joins are contemporaneous associations. A significant future-reserve lead is a warning for common shocks, dependence or timing issues, not evidence of causality.

H4.title: RBI repo-rate effective-date event study
H4.null: Mean three-session abnormal return (CAR) around supplied repo effective dates equals zero; paired alternative: event CAR differs between indices.
H4.alternative: Mean CAR is nonzero or CAR distributions/sensitivity differ across index segments.
H4.definition: Event CAR is sum of daily returns in [t-1,t,t+1] minus 3 times the mean daily return in estimation window [t-120,t-21].

Nifty Auto.method: Two-sided one-sample t-test of event CAR mean = 0; effective dates are proxy event dates
